# H&H Construction

> Commercial concrete construction, asphalt paving, and metal buildings and
> roofing for general contractors, developers, municipalities, school
> districts, and commercial property owners across Oklahoma.

H&H Construction is a commercial and industrial contractor based in Norman,
Oklahoma. Most contractors in this market specialize in a single trade; H&H
delivers concrete, asphalt, and pre-engineered metal building scopes under one
contract, which removes the coordination burden from the general contractor.

- Phone: 405-476-5476
- Email: logan@hhbuildok.com
- Based in: Norman, Oklahoma

## Services

- [Commercial Concrete Construction](https://hhbuildok.com/services/concrete-construction):
  Structural foundations and footings, slab-on-grade and structural slabs,
  sidewalks, curbs and gutters, retaining walls, and site concrete.
- [Commercial Asphalt Paving](https://hhbuildok.com/services/asphalt-paving):
  New commercial and industrial paving, overlays and resurfacing, patching,
  parking lot construction and rehabilitation, and municipal roadways.
  City pages: [Norman](https://hhbuildok.com/services/asphalt-paving/norman),
  [Oklahoma City](https://hhbuildok.com/services/asphalt-paving/oklahoma-city),
  [Edmond](https://hhbuildok.com/services/asphalt-paving/edmond),
  [Moore](https://hhbuildok.com/services/asphalt-paving/moore),
  [Yukon](https://hhbuildok.com/services/asphalt-paving/yukon),
  [Midwest City](https://hhbuildok.com/services/asphalt-paving/midwest-city),
  [Tulsa](https://hhbuildok.com/services/asphalt-paving/tulsa).
- [Commercial Parking Lots](https://hhbuildok.com/services/commercial-parking-lots):
  Asphalt or concrete lot construction and reconstruction, site concrete,
  curb and gutter, approaches, striping, ADA flatwork, and Division 32
  exterior improvements for commercial properties across Oklahoma.
- [Commercial Foundations](https://hhbuildok.com/services/commercial-foundations):
  Spread footings, stem walls, slab-on-grade, structural slabs, equipment
  pads, anchor bolt layouts for metal buildings, and Division 03 structural
  concrete for warehouses, retail, medical, and institutional projects
  across Oklahoma.
- [Commercial Metal Buildings](https://hhbuildok.com/services/commercial-metal-buildings):
  Pre-engineered metal building erection, red iron framing, anchor bolt
  coordination, wall and roof systems, metal roofing, and Division 13 scope
  for warehouses, industrial, municipal, and commercial projects across
  Oklahoma.
- [Metal Buildings & Roofing](https://hhbuildok.com/services/metal-buildings-roofing):
  Pre-engineered metal building erection, warehouse and industrial facility
  structures, commercial metal roofing systems, and building shells.

## Service Area

Primary: Oklahoma City, Edmond, Norman, Moore, Yukon, Mustang, Midwest City,
Del City, and Shawnee. Projects are also evaluated statewide, including Tulsa,
Broken Arrow, Stillwater, Enid, Lawton, and Ardmore.

## Who H&H Works With

General contractors, developers, municipalities, school districts, commercial
property owners, and industrial facilities.
